# Minimum engine environment

Status: Version preparation verified (2026-10-01). This is not plugin compatibility or real model proof.

## Environment and commands

The isolated scratch environment is `/tmp/DSR-minimum-engine-o5lHG1/venv`, with its own cache beside it. Python is 3.13.15 and uv is 0.12.10. Only the SDK wheel and its dependencies were installed; the plugin and its source lock were not changed. Installation retained the two week cooldown, required binary wheels and used the public PyPI index. The first sandbox attempt failed DNS resolution; the approved network retry succeeded.

```text
uv venv --no-config --no-project --no-python-downloads --python <repo>/python/claude_agent_sdk/.venv/bin/python --cache-dir /tmp/DSR-minimum-engine-o5lHG1/cache /tmp/DSR-minimum-engine-o5lHG1/venv
uv pip install --no-config --no-sources --no-python-downloads --python /tmp/DSR-minimum-engine-o5lHG1/venv/bin/python --cache-dir /tmp/DSR-minimum-engine-o5lHG1/cache --default-index https://pypi.org/simple --exclude-newer '2 weeks' --only-binary :all: 'claude-agent-sdk==0.2.153'
```

## Observed versions

Both binaries were invoked with `env -i PATH=/usr/bin:/bin <binary> -v` in the network restricted sandbox, without credential variables. Both exited zero.

| Lane | SDK wheel | Printed engine version | Engine SHA-256 |
|---|---|---|---|
| Minimum wheel | 0.2.153 | 2.1.273 (Claude Code) | 6c752e2cc7c110c9df15f26d8d134d438c5ae95dbd610efc1a308bf7f9c5f6c1 |
| Repaired local baseline | 0.2.154 | 2.1.274 (Claude Code) | 15e2d05148f801b5774032faad87e624ecd172e9903288bda448b892eb58fa07 |

The plugin declares wheel `>=0.2.153` and engine floor `(2, 1, 273)`. These observations establish that this minimum wheel bundles the floor engine. The repaired baseline is not a selected newest engine lane. DSR-1.1's minimum plus newest acceptance criterion therefore remains open. No model prompt, plugin compatibility suite on the minimum lane, or preventive budget test ran. Scratch paths may disappear; the version strings, hashes, commands and dependency inventory preserve the result.
